title: शरणार्थी उपन्यासमा “जयमाया आफूमात्र लिखापानी आइपुगी’
nepali: प्रस्तुत लेख विनिर्माणको विपठनसँग सम्बन्धित छ । आख्यान कुनै बेला इतिहास जस्तो, कुनै बेला राजनीति जस्तो, कुनै बेला पत्रकारिता जस्तो, कुनै बेला निबन्ध जस्तो, कुनै बेला कथा जस्तो, नाटकजस्तो, समालोचना जस्तो, कविता जस्तो र कुनै बेला संस्मरण जस्तो धरै जस्तो बन्न जानु विनिर्माण हो । कृष्णधरावासीको शरणार्थी भित्र सङ्गृहीत ‘जयमाया’ खण्ड यस्तै विपठनको उदाहरण हो । ‘जयमाया’ इन्द्रबहादुर राईको ‘जयमाया आफूमात्र लिखापानी आइपुगी’ कथाको पुनर्पठन हो । पात्र, परिवेश, विषयवस्तु, शीर्षक आदि कुरामा पुनर्पठन हुनु विनिर्माण हुनु हो । यिनै उत्तरआधुनिताको छाता भित्रको विनिर्माण र विनिर्माणभित्रको पनि विपठनलाई लिएर शरणार्थी उपन्यसको जयमाया खण्ड विश्लेषण गरिएको छ ।
american_english: The present article is concerned with the misreading of deconstruction. Fiction coming to resemble many things—at times like history, at times like politics, at times like journalism, at times like an essay, at times like a story, like drama, like criticism, like poetry, and at times like a memoir—is deconstruction. The 'Jayamaya' section collected within Krishna Dharabasi's Sharanarthi is an example of such a misreading. 'Jayamaya' is a rereading of Indra Bahadur Rai's story 'Jayamaya Aaphumatra Likhapani Aaipugi'. Undergoing a rereading in terms of characters, setting, subject matter, title, and other elements constitutes deconstruction. Taking deconstruction under the umbrella of postmodernism and specifically misreading within deconstruction, the Jayamaya section of the novel Sharanarthi has been analyzed.

informal_english: This article is all about the misreading side of deconstruction, eh. Fiction ending up resembling pretty much everything—at times like history, at times like politics, at times like journalism, at times like an essay, at times like a story, like drama, like criticism, like poetry, and at times like a memoir—that is deconstruction. The 'Jayamaya' section collected inside Krishna Dharabasi's Sharanarthi is an example of just such a misreading. 'Jayamaya' is basically a rereading of Indra Bahadur Rai's story 'Jayamaya Aaphumatra Likhapani Aaipugi'. Having a rereading in terms of characters, setting, subject matter, title, and all that is what deconstruction is. Taking deconstruction under the umbrella of postmodernism and specifically misreading within deconstruction, the Jayamaya section of the novel Sharanarthi has been analyzed here.
translator_notes: Source text contains minor typographical errors: 'धरै जस्तो' for 'धेरै जस्तो', 'उत्तरआधुनिताको' for 'उत्तरआधुनिकताको', and 'उपन्यसको' for 'उपन्यासको'. Literary critical terms विनिर्माण (deconstruction), विपठन (misreading/counter-reading), and पुनर्पठन (rereading) are rendered consistently. Story and novel titles are transliterated. Strict sentence order preserved. Informal flavour: Canadian casual.
